messages:
Carla G.: heads up — nightly backups show two recent snapshots encrypted with a different CMK than prod canonical key :rotating_light:
Priya R.: oh? did someone rotate the CMK or did backup-agent pick up a per-tenant key?
Carla G.: I pulled the object metadata; S3 object header `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id` points to `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-tenant-key` not `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/prod-cmk`.
Mark C.: we rolled an RBAC change yesterday that removed broad `kms:Decrypt` from the `backup-agent` role and replaced with a grant pattern scoped to `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/tenant-*` to test isolation. Maybe agent fell back and generated a tenant-scoped CMK?
Priya R.: backup-agent shouldn't be creating keys. Could be the upload pipeline used `SSE-KMS` but with caller-specified KeyId — the agent can set it if config wasn't pinned.
Carla G.: audit-bot found 9 PutObject events from `backup-agent` between 02:10-02:18. Also 2 `CreateKey` calls by `backup-agent@infra` at 02:09. audit-bot: `createKey` events -> keyId: `abcd-tenant-key` (created with tag `temp: true`).
audit-bot: export available at s3://audit-exports/2024-06-05/cloudtrail-ct-export.csv
sec-oncall: tagging looks like our ephemeral grant test leaked to prod, escalating. Immediate mitigation: stop restores from suspect snapshots and revoke grants until we verify key policy. :lock:
Mark C.: action list — 1) snapshot quarantine, 2) revoke `CreateGrant` for that key, 3) temporarily re-grant `kms:Decrypt` to backup-agent for prod-cmk with strict condition, 4) run integrity checks.
Priya R.: commands I'm running:
```
# check object metadata
aws s3api head-object --bucket rw-backups-prod --key snapshots/2024-06-05/backup-001.tar.gz
# list kms events
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=CreateKey --start-time 2024-06-04T22:00:00Z
# revoke grants
aws kms retire-grant --grant-id <grant-id> --key-id abcd-tenant-key
```
Carla G.: I'm patching the agent config in staging to pin `KMS_KEY_ID` to prod-cmk and adding a validation to fail uploads when unset.
ops-runbook-bot: suggested playbook `encops/quarantine-and-verify` recommended; see https://wiki/redwood/encops/quarantine — runbook invoked.
deploy-bot: RBAC change from yesterday rolled by infra-deploy at 2024-06-04T21:45Z (deploy-789).
Mark C.: audit request: include `iam:ChangeRole` and `kms:CreateKey` in the list of events to scan for since 2024-06-01. Priya, can you get a CSV export from CloudTrail?
Priya R.: on it. exporting now — will post results here. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Carla G.: timeline update: quarantined 4 objects, blocked restore path, added temporary policy to allow decrypt from `backup-agent` for prod-cmk until 22:00 UTC. Need security signoff before re-enabling automatic uploads.
sec-oncall: got it. after CSV and key-policy verification we'll decide whether to rotate prod-cmk or re-encrypt snapshots. For now label incident `INC-20240605-CMK-MISMATCH`.
Carla G.: ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-20240605-CMK-MISMATCH — assign sec-oncall and Mark C.
audit-bot: exported CloudTrail CSV to /tmp/ct-export-20240605.csv and uploaded to secure-share.
Priya R.: initial diff looks like 3 tenant-created keys and 1 prod fallback key usage. I'll run `aws kms schedule-key-deletion` only after we confirm no customer data is left on tenant keys.
Mark C.: thanks. good catch team. let's keep replies brief here for paging.
